description: This file defines an interface for a streaming history grain in an Orleans-based distributed system, specifying methods for managing stream consumption and retrieval of received items.

classes.name: IStreamingHistoryGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that manages streaming history, allowing it to become a consumer, stop being a consumer, and retrieve received items.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Sets the grain to become a consumer of a specified stream, with optional filter data.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Stops the grain from consuming streams.

methods.name: GetReceivedItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of received items as integers.
